versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Woodland smugglers who push their luck each turn: every optional Run pays off but adds Heat, and going over the Limit gets a unit Seized.
One half pays for stopping just short; the other turns high Heat into Attack and buys Seized units back bigger.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording fixes so the cards read cleanly: Pebble Jack's skipped roll stays, Creel-Weaver's extra Run doesn't retrigger, Grisel hits once and steals a one-Tag copy, and you choose Run order.
Hothead now grows permanently each time you're Caught, giving the Hot build a growth curve; Slipway Champion reads as its own push-your-luck game.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
